newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RANGERS BEAT HIBS 3-1 TO RESTORE LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RANGERS BEAT HIBS 3-1 TO RESTORE LEAD.

text.p: Glasgow Rangers beat Hibernian 3-1 on Sunday to re-establish their seven-point lead over rivals Celtic at the top of the Scottish premier division.
Captain Richard Gough put the champions ahead three minutes into the match, heading home a cross from Denmark's Brian Laudrup for his sixth goal of the season.
Rangers, without injured England midfielder Paul Gascoigne and Chilean striker Sebastian Rozental, took control but failed to increase their lead before the interval.

Four minutes after the restart they won a penalty when Gordon Durie, re-establishing himself in the side after a prolonged absence through injury, was pulled down by Shaun Dennis. German Joerg Albertz converted the spot-kick.

Dennis redeemed himself by pulling a goal back for Hibs five minutes later before Laudrup restored Rangers' two-goal lead, sliding the ball through the legs of veteran Scottish goalkeeper Jim Leighton.
Hibs' David Elliot was sent off for violent conduct 15 minutes from time for a foul on Derek McInnes.
Rangers have 67 points to Celtic's 60. Both sides have nine league matches to play and are due to face each other on March 16.
